meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 Telegram 机器人频道接进项目:复制 Telegram 适配器与辅助代码、注册频道和配对步骤、安装指定依赖,然后跑构建和集成测试;接着引导你创建机器人、保存令牌、重启服务,并用 4 位配对码把某个对话绑定为频道。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Telegram 频道、添加 Telegram 机器人支持,或提到用 Chat SDK 集成 Telegram 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目接入 Telegram 频道
say.note: 它会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖,然后引导你创建机器人。

say.text: 我想通过 Chat SDK 添加 Telegram 机器人支持
say.note: 它会跑构建和测试,并提示用 BotFather 创建机器人。

say.text: 给项目配上 Telegram 频道,然后和我的私聊配对
say.note: 它会生成 4 位配对码,你把码发给机器人即可完成绑定。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Telegram channel support: it copies the adapter/helpers/tests, registers them, installs the pinned package, builds, and runs the test. Then it helps create a bot, store its token, restart, and pair a chat with a 4-digit code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK, add Telegram bot support, or connect Telegram to the project.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel support to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, then guides bot creation.

say_en.text: I want Telegram bot support through Chat SDK.
say_en.note: Builds and runs the integration test.

say_en.text: Set up a Telegram channel and pair it with my private chat.
say_en.note: Prints a 4-digit code; send it to the bot to finish pairing.
